# ICM Architect vendor pin

Owned inventory for the pinned RinDig/icm-architect companion. Skill,
references, and templates track upstream. ChaosEngine nests the upstream
skill root under `skills/icm-architect/` so host plugins discover it the
same way as Caveman and Ponytail. No ChaosEngine overlay is applied to
upstream bodies.
